entries.8f1eb2aa1f5444d5: The company is headquartered in Kariya, Aichi Prefecture, and the company, 8 subsidiaries and 1 affiliate form the group. Its main businesses are the manufacture and sale of automotive parts, control systems and robot systems; it also conducts motorsports, leasing and solar power, and non-life insurance agency businesses. Consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended November 2025 numbered 746.
entries.94a1165ddc6114f8: This business operates circuit facilities. Subsidiary Okayama International Circuit Co., Ltd. operates the circuit facility, and subsidiary Chimu Ruman Co., Ltd. conducts automobile racing operations. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥1,410 million.
entries.a717954bd89576a1: This business leases warehouses and factories and sells electricity generated by solar power. The company conducts this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥152 million.
entries.cafae2791b4f9d80: This business manufactures and sells automotive parts such as pillars, side roof rails, floor cross members, radiator supports and others. The company manufactures and sells these parts; subsidiary AMI Inc. designs, manufactures and sells molds; subsidiary PT.AUTO ASKA INDONESIA manufactures and sells automotive parts; and affiliate N&A Tech Inc. also manufactures and sells automotive parts. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥36,254 million.
entries.ece7c6909d68b4f1: This business manufactures and sells industrial robots (Yunirobo), automation systems, control devices, information and communication equipment and others. The company manufactures and sells these products; subsidiary Jasutisu Inc. and subsidiary MIRAI-LAB Inc. design, manufacture and sell robot systems; and subsidiary ASKA USA CORPORATION carries out manufacturing, sales and maintenance. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥5,120 million.
